evidence.content: This report maps the active pipeline to the production Orders API repository. Builds and unit tests run on every commit. Twenty successful executions are recorded this week.
The Orders API database has encryption at rest enabled. Connection encryption has not been verified.

The application uses container-managed EJB services. The current application server supplies these services. Plain Tomcat does not provide this EJB container. A replacement implementation and compatibility tests have not been completed.

questions.text: Is continuous integration actively used for this application?
questions.rubric: Yes requires recent execution evidence for commit-triggered builds and tests in the application repository. A pipeline file alone is insufficient. No requires explicit evidence that CI is not used.

choices.No: CI is explicitly not in use.

questions.text: Is application data encrypted both at rest and on database connections?
questions.rubric: Yes requires evidence of encryption at rest AND on all scoped database connections. Partial evidence is insufficient. No requires explicit unencrypted storage or connections.

choices.No: At least one scope is explicitly unencrypted.

questions.text: Describe the implications of replacing the application server with plain Tomcat.
questions.rubric: Describe only documented dependencies, gaps and necessary work. Do not assert successful compatibility or a completed test.
Requires accountable-owner confirmation of an approved funding record.

questions.text: Is the approved RTO at most 60 minutes?
questions.rubric: Evaluate the currently approved RTO. If authoritative records disagree, return a conflict rather than selecting a preferred record.

choices.Yes: Approved RTO is at most 60 minutes.
